input: Research accessible travel destinations for elderly parents

gold.taskTitle: Research Accessible Travel Destinations for Elderly Parents
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify travel destinations that are suitable and accessible for elderly parents, accounting for their specific mobility, health, and comfort needs.

questions.title: What country or region are your parents based in?
questions.description: Understanding their home base helps determine travel distance, visa requirements, and logical departure points.

questions.title: What specific mobility limitations do your parents have?
questions.description: Knowing whether they use wheelchairs, walkers, or have general fatigue issues shapes what accessibility features are non-negotiable.

questions.title: What type of trip are they hoping to take?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the goal is a beach holiday, cultural city tour, nature retreat, cruise, or something else entirely.

questions.title: How long should the trip ideally last?
questions.description: Duration affects destination shortlisting, stamina planning, and the depth of research needed.

questions.title: What is the approximate budget for this trip?
questions.description: Budget determines the tier of accommodation, transport options, and whether private accessibility services are viable.

questions.title: Are there any medical conditions requiring specific facilities nearby?
questions.description: Conditions like heart disease or diabetes may require proximity to hospitals or access to specific medications or dietary needs.

questions.title: When are your parents planning to travel?
questions.description: The target timeframe affects seasonal suitability, crowd levels, climate comfort, and how urgently the research needs to be completed.
